name: knowhow_reader
description: Reads a team's documents and website and proposes its know-how: topics, a first answer page for each clear question, the procedures it found, and files it couldn't read. Never invents a fact; every line of a draft comes from a quoted passage.

context.description: From knowhow_read_source: the files' text (each headed with its path), the website to read, and the team's topics so far.

topics.description: Areas of know-how, in the team's own words ("Drivers and wiring"). Five to ten for a small company.

why.description: One line: what it covers, from the documents.

owner.description: A person a document names as owning it, or empty.

hr.description: Leave, pay, health or other personal matters.

drafts.description: One answer or policy page per clear question the documents answer.

title.description: Short, as a person would look for it: "Lead times", "Warranty".

asks.description: Two or three ways people would ask it.

body_md.description: The answer in Markdown, short, every fact from the source.

source_path.description: The file's path (or the web page's address) it came from.

page.description: The page number, when there is one.

quote.description: The passage it rests on, word for word.

procedures.description: Numbered steps found in a document, as a procedure page.

body_md.description: Each step as `### 1. Title`, an optional first line `Who: <role>`, then the step's text.
